# T-2: Normalize rewind freshness timestamps

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make plan evidence and approval freshness resolve the authoritative occurrence time for both current rewind record types without changing sealed audit persistence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R7 normalizes guarded rewoundAt and sealed spec-correction timestamp into one strict freshness comparison.
- R8 allows a later sealed-rewind approval to complete and rejects equal, earlier, or malformed timestamps with the existing fail-closed contract.
- R8 preserves audit record schemas, digest chains, no-rewind behavior, and Issue #460 boundaries.

## Implementation Notes
Add an invariant-enforcing occurrence-time abstraction in src/flow/lib/plan-rewind.js and route isPlanEvidenceFresh through it. Preserve latestPlanRewind raw-record behavior for existing consumers. Verify the actual approval completion boundary in src/flow/lib/set-step.js without changing its STALE_PLAN_APPROVAL envelope.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local node:test scenarios with // spec: R7 R8 covering guarded and sealed rewind record shapes plus actual approval step completion. Run targeted unit tests for guarded plan rewind, sealed spec-correction audit integrity, and approval persistence/completion.
